meeting.title: Board pre-read review: Transforming retail through advanced analytics & AI

asks.text: Give slide 15 an action title that states the Starbucks result with the engagement and revenue figures already on the slide.

refs.quote: This slide just says we did well, it should tell them what happened.

refs.speaker: Ines Duarte
refs.quote: Drop tripled. Use the 150 for engagement. And can we get the revenue in too?

refs.speaker: Ines Duarte
refs.quote: Maybe Starbucks in it, so they know whose number it is.

changes.rationale: The topic title becomes a result the board can repeat, naming Starbucks and both figures on the slide.

refs.speaker: Arjun Bose
refs.quote: The plus 100 million in year one, yeah. That's on the same slide, so it's not a new number either.

refs.speaker: Ines Duarte
refs.quote: And not tripled anywhere, please, I don't want my word coming back to bite me.

op.new: Starbucks personalization lifted marketing engagement 150% and added $100M net incremental revenue in year 1

held.text: Slide 14's title waits until the client has settled what the propensity table shows.
